method.live: scan /proc/*/cmdline for headless_shell; browser instances identified by --no-startup-window; our own processes identified by PPid == this census process, so this file reports only OTHER lines.
method.retroactive: absolute process start = /proc/stat btime + /proc/<pid>/stat field 22 / 100 Hz; a process whose start precedes a batch end was alive during that batch.
method.limitation: lower bound: exited processes leave no trace; per-window counts for the historical batches were NOT recorded live and cannot be reconstructed.

unlocked.directObservation: During this batch `ps` was used live and recorded >=3 concurrent headless Chromium instances on this host; tab-profile also leaked its own crashed-run browser from 15:04 until 15:28. Both are recorded in audit.md section 3.
unlocked.caveat: LOWER BOUND ONLY: processes that started and exited during the batch are invisible to /proc after the fact, so a lower bound of 0 does NOT prove exclusivity.
unlocked.status: NOT EXCLUSIVE (refuted by direct observation during the batch; retrospectively invisible)

evidence.note: started BEFORE the batch and is STILL alive -> it was alive for 100% of the batch

locked.directObservation: The lock was HELD by tab-profile for 42/42 windows, yet >=1 foreign browser instance was alive for the whole window (proved by process start time below).
locked.caveat: LOWER BOUND ONLY: processes that started and exited during the batch are invisible to /proc after the fact, so a lower bound of 0 does NOT prove exclusivity.
locked.status: NOT EXCLUSIVE (refuted): at least one foreign browser was alive during the batch

conclusion.unlockedBatch: NOT EXCLUSIVE (refuted by direct observation during the batch; retrospectively invisible)
conclusion.lockedBatch: NOT EXCLUSIVE (refuted): at least one foreign browser was alive during the batch
conclusion.headline: No tab-profile batch was exclusive, including the one whose lock tab-profile actually held. Per the standing order no further browser was launched to retry: exclusivity was empirically unobtainable (the coordinator measured 0/5 exclusive windows and 18-31 foreign Playwright processes per window during another line's 1635s lock hold).
